description.value: A creator capsule is a small 3D printer with a programmable interface that allows you to quickly Craft items using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Fabricator] skill feat. Unlike normal Crafting, this process takes 24 hours of work to set up and complete, but you can't spend additional downtime days working on it to reduce the value of the materials you need to expend to complete the item. You must have the item's formula and can't Craft items with a level higher than the level of the creator capsule. Crafting items with more than 1 Bulk requires using an additional creator capsule for each additional Bulk, but you still roll to Craft only once.
